reason: The cited evidence (E2) confirms Cr-V-rich precipitates form in W38Ta36Cr15V11 at 8 dpa, but neither E1 nor E2 provides any data on Hf addition, its effect on diffusivity, or its impact on precipitate suppression in this alloy system.
